exactRule: WHEN the scissors close through the paper, THE paper to the right of the blades ALWAYS folds upright along the blade line instead of separating.

source.strategy: Mimi opens the scissors, turns the paper a quarter-turn, and closes the blades along the next side of the square.
source.visibleConsequence: The paper to the blades' right folds upright, leaving two adjoining walls around the still-attached square and a buckled paper corner.
source.newInformation: Turning the sheet changes which outer flap rises, not whether the scissors cut.

perBeat.sourceReview: The next-side blade closure is explicit. The right-hand paper flap folds upright; accumulation changes wall count, not the causal function. No contradiction detected.

source.strategy: Mimi tilts the sheet toward herself to reach the third outlined side and closes the scissors through it.
source.visibleConsequence: A third outer flap folds upright to the blades' right, making a three-sided paper enclosure with the scissors entering through its open side.
source.newInformation: The remaining open side is now the only unobstructed approach to the outline.

perBeat.sourceReview: Tilting the sheet changes approach. Closure through side three again raises the right-hand flap. Same trigger and target; unchanged accepted rule test passes.

source.strategy: Mimi slides the open scissors through that gap and positions the blades on the final outlined side, keeping the handles inside the enclosure.
source.visibleConsequence: As the blades close through the paper, the fourth outer flap folds upright to their right, forming a paper box around the scissors.
source.newInformation: Completing the outline encloses the tool instead of freeing the square.

perBeat.sourceReview: Positioning is described in strategy; closure is explicit in visibleConsequence. The fourth right-hand flap forms another wall. The fields together make the activation auditable.

source.strategy: Mimi points the scissors upward inside the box and closes them through the top edge of its front wall to make an exit.
source.visibleConsequence: The wall section to the blades' right folds inward across the box, leaving the scissors' two handle loops protruding above a paper lid.
source.newInformation: Trying to cut an escape folds part of the enclosure over the trapped tool.
